note: Station pairs across the Andes: QNH west (Pacific side) minus QNH east. Only pairs with a published rule raise the score. High-altitude stations (Bolivian altiplano, Peruvian sierra) are left out: their QNH is reduced from 3,000–4,000 m and does not compare with a coastal QNH.

pairs.name: Santiago – Mendoza
pairs.rule: Pilot rule of thumb: Santiago QNH 8–12 hPa or more above Mendoza, or Mendoza 5 °C or more warmer (Aviación Global; not confirmed by an official source)
